title.narrative: Reducing TB incidence and TB related mortality among Somalis

description.narrative: Somalia - Tuberculosis - World Vision International - WVI Somalia. This program has the following goals: The reduce the TB incidence from 250/100,000 in 2021 to 190/100,000 in 2026.. The objectives of this program are: The goal is to increase TB case notification from the current 17,422 tin 2021 to 26,966 in 2026, and maintain treatment success rate of 90% by end of 2026.. To increase the number of RR/MDR TB cases enrolled on treatment from 345 in 2022 to 1047 in 2026.. To increase the treatment success rate of RR/MDR TB from 78% in the cohort of 2020 to >85% in the cohort of 2024.. To increase number of all diagnosed TB patients are tested for HIV and are aware of their HIV status, and to increase the proportion of TB/HIV coinfected patients on ART from the current 84% to above 90% by 2026.
